title: REQ · History effect never updates state after it is cancelled
summary: Cancel guard covers both resolve and reject paths
description: Context: the effect has a cancelled flag checked only in .then; .catch has no guard. Desired behavior: every state write (status and entries) in both .then and .catch is skipped once the cleanup ran. Expected result: no updates after close, roundId change or unmount. Why: avoid stale or leaked updates.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sheet closes while listMine is pending, When it later rejects, Then no error message is rendered on reopen before the new load settles
Given roundId changes while the first request is pending, When the first resolves, Then its entries are not added
Given the component unmounts, When listMine settles, Then no React state-update warning is logged

in_scope: cancelled checks in then and catch
preserve: Merge of history with in-flight sent entries

technical_constraints: Guard by local cancelled flag set in effect cleanup
